description: Very versatile. Check the video for extra tips regarding specifics like english counterplay, eco distribution, landmark and building placing, army comps etc.
name: Beasty's 2TC Song Opening [S5]
author: paleblood

notes: Before vils drop wood, after IO is created, make a mill @building_economy/mill.png@ (preferably next to berries) , dont shift click the vils!
IO@unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@ supervises the mill while its being built so that the vils drop off wood immediately after they are done building and you get extra 20% from that wood.
Next vil @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ builds a village @building_chinese/village.png@ next to the mill. Then gathers food @resource/resource_food.png@.
Next vil @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ goes to straggler wood @resource/resource_wood.png@, gathers only 3 and force drops off. Then he builds gold mine @building_economy/mining-camp.png@.
Next 2 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@, you want 3 vils mining gold total.
Next 3 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go to food @resource/resource_food.png@. Remember to gather tax from mill once it gets to 40, then keep supervising mill.

Either build Barbican @landmark_chinese/barbican-of-the-sun.webp@ with 2 vils or Imp. Academy @landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.png@ with 3 vils. Use food vils. They return to food @resource/resource_food.png@ once they are done.
Once you have 10 vils on food, next 2 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go to straggler wood@resource/resource_wood.png@.

Build the second feudal landmark (@landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.webp@or@landmark_chinese/barbican-of-the-sun.png@) with 4 vils from food. They go to wood @resource/resource_wood.png@ once they are done. You should leave 6 vils on food for now.
Once you have 160 gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@ take all vils from gold to straggler wood @resource/resource_wood.png@. Research wheelbarrow @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@
Build a lumber camp @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ and supervise it with your IO @unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@.

Use 4 wood vils to build eitther barracks @building_military/barracks.png@ or archery range @building_military/archery-range.png@, they go mine stone @resource/resource_stone.png@ after they are done, supervise the stone mine too with the second IO@unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@.
Remember to keep picking up tax constantly from all camps.

You can start making some small walls @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@ with a single vil from wood @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ or a tower@building_defensive/outpost.png@ to protect resources/gain vision. Dont spend too much wood  or second TC is gonna get delayed.
Build the second TC @building_economy/town-center.webp@ , use vils from stone.
Make the fourth IO @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@. Three supervise each resource and one gathers tax. Reorganize your economy according to your game plan.

If you're going against an aggressive opponent : 15 vils on food@resource/resource_food.webp@, 15 on wood@resource/resource_wood.png@, 6 on gold@resource/resource_gold.png@, rally @resource/rally.png@both TCs to food@resource/resource_food.png@ and start producing a defensive army@unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@@unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.png@ with its upgrades @building_technology/blacksmith.png@. Gradually prepare a farm@building_chinese/granary.png@@building_economy/farm.png@ transition. Eventually, when you have around 40 on food, you can start rallying to gold instead and you will "naturally" age up@age/age_3.png@. If opponent ages up, attack them and age up yourself.

If youre going against a passive opponent: Just age up to castle. Assign 6 vils@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to gold@resource/resource_gold.png@ and move all but 6 vils from wood@resource/resource_wood.png@ to food@resource/resource_food.png@.
If your opponent wasnt agressive, advance to castle with the Clocktower @landmark_chinese/astronomical-clocktower.webp@, use 8 vils to build it.

At this point start rallying @resource/rally.webp@ to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@ until you have 15 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ on it and research imperial examinations @technology_chinese/imperial-examination.png@ because you will need a lot for unit and blacksmith upgrades @building_technology/blacksmith.png@, monks@unit_religious/monk-3.png@ and units. Create a stronger army @unit_chinese/palace-guard-3.png@@unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.png@with some nest of bees @unit_chinese/nest-of-bees.png@and secure relics @building_religious/monastery.png@@resource/relics.png@ if you can.

@age/age_2.webp@: Queue 1 @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ & gather 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from stragglers with your age-up @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@. Make sure you build a @building_chinese/village.webp@ and then @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@
Play out with units and contest deer. Then get castle and take relics. Decide on song if long feudal or add song after relic collection.
